summary: Complete testing of Resume Builder UX/UI overhaul. All 13 features tested successfully. Backend API (generate-summaries) returns 3 summary options correctly. Frontend flows: Entry page with Upload/Create cards, multi-step onboarding (experience level + industry selection), template selection, and editor with Review Card pattern for Experience/Education tabs all working correctly.
passed_tests: Entry page shows 'Upload Resume' and 'Create From Scratch' cards at /career-tools/resume-builder
Create From Scratch flow: Entry → Onboarding (experience level selection) → Industry selection → Template selection → Editor
Onboarding experience level buttons (No Experience, Entry-Level, Mid-Level, Senior-Level) visible with data-testid='level-*'
Industry selection step after choosing experience level (data-testid='onboarding-industry')
Template selection page after onboarding (data-testid='template-selection') with 5 templates
Editor loads after template selection with sidebar, form workspace, and live preview
Experience Tab: Review Card pattern - empty state shows 'Add Experience' button, adding experience shows edit form, clicking Done collapses to review card with Edit/Delete buttons
Education Tab: Same Review Card pattern as Experience - Add button, edit form, Done collapses to card with Edit/Delete
Personal Tab: 'Generate Summary' button (data-testid='generate-summary-btn') visible and functional
Generate Summary returns 3 AI-generated summary options that can be selected
Full-screen Tips button in editor toolbar (data-testid='full-tips-btn') opens full-screen Tips & Fixes view
Tips toggle in toolbar (data-testid='tips-toggle') opens side panel
Paste text option (data-testid='paste-option') opens paste mode with textarea and Parse Resume button
Backend API: POST /api/career-tools/generate-summaries returns 3 summaries (verified with pytest)
critical_code_review_comments: ResumeBuilder.tsx: Well-structured flow states (entry, processing, welcome, analysis, onboarding, templates, editor, fullTips)
CreateOnboarding.tsx: Clean 2-step onboarding with experience level and industry selection
ExperienceTab.tsx and EducationTab.tsx: Review Card pattern implemented correctly with edit/collapse toggle
PersonalTab.tsx: Generate Summary button integrates with backend API and shows 3-option picker
All interactive elements have proper data-testid attributes for testing
Backend generate-summaries endpoint correctly returns exactly 3 summary variations
